rules.title: Fair Employment and Housing Act Criminal History Restrictions
rules.requirement: Housing providers are prohibited from having blanket bans on renting to people with a criminal history and cannot consider arrests not leading to a conviction, sealed or expunged records, or juvenile justice records.

coverage.summary: Covers most housing accommodations in California.

rules.quoted_span: Housing providers are also prohibited from having “blanket bans” of all people with a criminal history.

rules.title: Fair Employment and Housing Act Source of Income Protection
rules.requirement: Housing providers cannot discriminate against tenants based on their source of income, which includes government rental assistance such as Section 8 vouchers.

coverage.summary: Covers most housing accommodations in California.

rules.quoted_span: California law protects tenants from discrimination based on how a tenant will be paying rent (“source of income”).
